The objective is to gain insight into solutions available on the market, their capabilities, and suppliers' ability to meet current and future needs in clinical diagnostics. The purpose of this Request for Information (RFI) is to collect information to support procurement planning. This RFI is neither a contract notice nor a request for tender and does not obligate the contracting authority to carry out a procurement procedure.
